targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.ASN_owner, d.client_asname, 'Desconhecido') AS provedor,
    count(DISTINCT d.client_ip) AS total_clientes
FROM download d
LEFT JOIN ASNS a ON d.client_asn = a.ASN
WHERE $__timeFilter(d.test_time)
    AND COALESCE(a.ASN_owner, d.client_asname, 'Desconhecido') IN ($isp)
GROUP BY provedor
ORDER BY total_clientes DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT
    d.client_latitude AS lat,
    d.client_longitude AS lon,
    d.client_ip,
    COALESCE(a.ASN_owner, d.client_asname, 'Desconhecido') AS isp_name,
    d.client_country_code AS country_name,
    d.client_city,
    count() AS total_testes
FROM download d
LEFT JOIN ASNS a ON d.client_asn = a.ASN
WHERE $__timeFilter(d.test_time)
    AND COALESCE(a.ASN_owner, d.client_asname, 'Desconhecido') IN ($isp)
    AND d.client_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND d.client_longitude IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.client_latitude, d.client_longitude, d.client_ip, isp_name, d.client_country_code, d.client_city

list.name: isp
list.query:
SELECT ASN_owner AS __text, ASN_owner AS __value
FROM ASNS
WHERE ASN_owner IS NOT NULL AND ASN_owner != ''
GROUP BY ASN_owner
ORDER BY ASN_owner
